in_marathi.name: Tisha
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे New beginning, auspiciousness
in_marathi.long_meaning: Tisha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A Sanskrit name derived from the root 'tish' which means 'new'. This name signifies the beginning of a new journey in life. It is also considered an auspicious name and is associated with good luck and prosperity.
